description:
Hardware-accelerated, scalable(scalability of SIMD tested on Linux-(Centos tested)) SIMD vector and GPU calculation pipelines for ParserNG.
        Fastest Java math evaluator in the world period
        Rich and Performant, Cross Platform Java Library(100% Java).No native dependencies.(e.g. JNI) 
        Version 3.0.5 features the addition of parser-ng-arrow, our integration with Apache Arrow, and other prior features like GPU bulk evaluation for OpenCL(tested), CUDA and Metal(new)
        of which benefit from CPU Pinning to minimize cache thrashing and other stories. This leads to highly efficient worker-count to output velocity conversion. 
        For library support, customizations or donations, reach me at gbenroscience@gmail.com|+2348165779034
